ops.text: CI takes the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml
ops.why: For the baseline's rust.ci-reads-toolchain (release 2026.10): the seven dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable steps in ci.yml, deny.yml and notices.yml became `rustup toolchain install`, which installs what rust-toolchain.toml pins (channel, clippy / rustfmt / rust-analyzer, the wasm32-unknown-unknown target), so CI and a fresh clone build with the same toolchain and there is no second version to drift. The one exception is Miri's job: Miri exists only on nightly, so it keeps dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly and runs `cargo +nightly miri` (commented in ci.yml). Jobs needing more targets add them with rustup (wasm32-wasip1 in no-std). Rendered with the user's `tend baseline render --write` (releases 2026.10 to 2026.10.3, closing their three todos); ci.private-deps (deploy keys) has nothing to apply until CI reads a private repo (the tend check job, which waits on tend's releases).
